title: Use `is TalkerDioLogger` instead of a runtimeType.toString() string match in dio_client_test.dart
why: Comparing runtimeType.toString() to a string literal bypasses the type system: a rename or a subclass would silently break or falsely pass this check with a confusing failure message, where `is TalkerDioLogger` (talker_dio_logger is already a transitive dependency of tool/lib/dio_client.dart) is both safer and clearer.
recommendation: Import package:talker_dio_logger/talker_dio_logger.dart and replace the check with `dio.interceptors.any((i) => i is TalkerDioLogger)`.
acceptance_criteria: Test uses an `is` type check, no runtimeType.toString() comparison remains, test still passes

corrections: talker_dio_logger is a direct (non-dev) pubspec dependency, not merely transitive as the finding states — makes the fix even easier, doesn't weaken the finding.
Finding calls talker_dio_logger a 'transitive dependency' but it's actually a direct pubspec dependency already imported by the file under test — doesn't change the finding's validity.
